title: Token-budget-aware thread summary: get_summary()
summary: MemoryStore.get_summary(scope, except_last=, token_budget=) returns a deterministic, budget-truncated plain-text transcript — distinct from get_context_card()'s LLM Summarizer hook.
description:
Oracle's thread.get_summary(except_last=N, token_budget=N) returns a plain-text, role-labeled transcript of a thread's messages — a distinct, simpler mechanism from get_context_card()'s optional LLM-based Summarizer hook (ORC-1): no LLM call, just a deterministic, budget-truncated raw-text view.

Add a Summary dataclass to types.py (content, message_count, truncated). Add MemoryStore.get_summary(scope, except_last=0, token_budget=None) -> Summary in its own new banner-comment section: chronological messages, drop the last except_last, format each as "{role} (-): {content}", and if token_budget is set, truncate via a documented whitespace-token approximation (never exceed budget), setting truncated=True.

Fully independent of THRD-1/2/3 — safe to run as a parallel subagent alongside them.
